text: Francesco Dellamorte keeps the cemetery in the small Italian town of Buffalora, where [the dead rise from their graves within seven nights|threat|the dead that rise] and he simply [puts them down with a gun|rules|it has a fatal weakness]. His only company is his assistant Gnaghi, who can say just one word. At a funeral he [falls for a young widow|trigger|love and desire], and as the dead keep returning his hold on reality slips, until [the leering figure of Death|images|ghosts and strange figures] tells him to stop killing the dead.
